definitions.meaning: A time of victory, the hour of victory

quotations.old_english: Wedra helm feónd gefylde . . . Ðæt ðam þeódne wæs síðes sigehwíl

source_text: sige-hwíl, e ; f. A time of victory, the hour of victory :--Wedra helm feónd gefylde . . . Ðæt ðam þeódne wæs síðes sigehwíl, Beo. Th. 5413 ; B. 2710.
